messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 31):
"""
Yes / No 1.6 If yes, Date of Launching of the Product DD/MM/YYYY 1.7 If no, proposed date of launching DD/MM/YYYY 1.8 Whether Product is catered to the Social Sector Yes / No Section II: Details of the Product 2.1 Type of Coverage Indemnity Yes/No Benefit Yes/No Both Indemnity & Benefit Yes/No Individual Yes/No Floater Yes/No 2.2 Structure of Base Cover offered in the Product S.No Name of the Benefit Whether Deductible allowed If yes, range of Deductible allowed Whether Co-Pay If yes, range of CoPay Yes/ No Minimum Maximum Yes/ No Minimum Maximum 2.3 Any sub limits imposed Yes / N< 3 Sub Limit in absolute terms (in INR) Sub Limit as a percentage
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
